subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw permit isolated cron jobs to inherit a global unattended-message recipient, and exactly which job types and creation surfaces should use that default?
rationale: The code shape is bounded, but recipient inheritance changes the privacy boundary for scheduled outbound messages and conflicts with an open proposal to make omitted delivery silent.

options.title: Add scoped delivery default
options.body: Support a validated default only for eligible isolated jobs that omit delivery, with explicit job settings always winning and recipient-safety tests.

options.title: Require explicit recipients
options.body: Reject global recipient inheritance and improve CLI and Control UI affordances for selecting or copying a destination per job.

options.title: Unify with output routing
options.body: Defer the narrow setting and resolve it as part of the broader deterministic output-routing design tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49078.

recommendation.title: Add scoped delivery default
recommendation.body: Support a validated default only for eligible isolated jobs that omit delivery, with explicit job settings always winning and recipient-safety tests.
